title: Sample multipart metadata
means: The page publishes main_module main.js, a plain_text MESSAGE binding and compatibility_date 2021-09-14.

title: keep_assets retains prior version assets
means: keep_assets retains assets from a previously uploaded Worker version in lieu of a completion token.

title: Upload without keep_assets drops old assets
means: keep_assets is optional and an upload with neither it nor a completion token does not retain old assets.

title: Invalid completion token refuses upload
means: A completion token authorizes attaching assets; malformed token takes the documented Workers upload error class.

title: Completion token expires after an hour
means: This completion token is valid for 1 hour. A late upload needs a new token and is refused by the upload error class.

title: Cron syntax: every minute
means: The documented cron example is accepted and stored: * * * * *

title: Cron syntax: minute step
means: The documented cron example is accepted and stored: */30 * * * *

title: Cron syntax: minute value
means: The documented cron example is accepted and stored: 45 * * * *

title: Cron syntax: case-insensitive weekday

title: Cron syntax: named weekday range

title: Cron syntax: first day of month

title: Cron syntax: last named weekday

title: Cron syntax: last weekday of month
